prose.name: Recovery: The Firm's Sample Case
prose.briefing: Raiders took a mining firm's sample case off a survey crew and are sitting on it at the <Place>. The firm wants it back unopened, delivered to its clerk in <SecondPlace>.

broadcast: The case is somewhere in that camp, and the firm would very much like it back before anyone gets curious. Bring it to me in the city, I'll be the one outside looking anxious.
_speech: Simon (ElevenLabs, unused in any Delve), a clerk out of his depth. His ear decides.

person.name: Corbin Fenwick
hellos: Is that it? Please tell me that's the case.

greeting: That's our case. I'd know those dents anywhere. Has anyone opened it?

reply: Still sealed. The firm will be delighted, and I might be allowed to go home.

exchanges.prompt: What's in it that matters so much?
